# RedPaw Companion

> A safer pet community app for dog owners — share moments, find pet care, report lost or found dogs, donate, adopt, and connect with nearby pet lovers.

RedPaw Companion helps dog owners keep their pets safe and connected. Core features include a social feed, lost & found dog alerts with location and sightings, care requests for sitters, donation campaigns, adoption listings, an in-app pet shop, and an AI assistant for pet questions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Social feed of community posts and updates from dog owners.
- [Community](/community): Lost & found dog alerts, care requests, donations, and adoptions.
- [Shop](/shop): In-app marketplace for pet products.
- [Pet Spots](/pet-spots): Dog-friendly places nearby.
- [Search](/search): Search users, dogs, and posts.
- [AI Assistant](/ai-chat): RedPaw AI chat for pet care questions and lost dog help.
- [Sign In](/auth): Account sign in and sign up.

## Optional

- [Notifications](/notifications): Personal notification feed (requires sign in).
- [Messages](/messages): Direct messaging (requires sign in).
- [Profile](/profile): User profile (requires sign in).
